meta.label_semantics: third_mechanism ≡ NOT spherical (ρ < 0.3): the spherical-geometry hypothesis is falsified and the interpretation requires revision — it does NOT assert that a third mechanism was identified (docs/E38_fixes.md part-5 §5)
meta.note: degenerate = any Procrustes step residual_sq > 0.9*2r (near-orthogonal subspaces); excluded from rho. degen_sweep reports degenerate_frac and rho_median at 0.7/0.9/0.95*2r (is the 0.9*2r cutoff an artifact?). trivial (theta≈0) is a valid Abelian result, not a bug. tr(H) and ‖H−I‖_F² are exact functions of {θ_j} (identity_check_max_absdiff). theta_all is NaN-padded (mixed spectrum may return < r//2 angles); n_dropped_nan counts the histogram dropouts. anomaly_count = non-trivial holonomy_spectrum warnings (π-boundary splits etc.; the π-loss bug was fixed in prism/holonomy.py). n_omega_skipped = triples with ‖h‖ < 1e-10 (Omega undefined, excluded from rho). p_med = median spearmanr p (asymptotic t-approximation, NOT permutation). H_012_doc0 (L23) is float64. consistency_e28 is a diagnostic with an empirical 5e-3 tolerance, not a hard verdict (1e-3 is tighter than the rounding of the cited 0.018).
